answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, held in escrow until finality, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the raven of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Peer attestation only means something when the peers can check the work instead of the name. The ivory is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the mirror. Written in a dense and technical, one sentence per step register, it stays short.
